The finite-chain tail recursion has equi-Lipschitz scaling and unique ODE limit S(t)=2−√(1+2t), giving child density (1+2t)^−1/2 and top atom 2−√3, then internal output density 2/(√(1+2t))−1 and atom 4−2√3. For m=2, false internal proportion π_1π_0=√3−3/2. Independent direct enumeration confirmed internal-node pair TOTAL identities for 8 (m,n) cases; the universal convergence is analytic.
